quotes.text: If you want results to hold together, you need hybrid keyword plus vector search, topped off with a semantic reranker that's built into Azure AI Search.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A concrete technical recommendation for making RAG retrieval reliable.

quotes.text: Multimodal doesn't collapse because the AI isn't smart enough. It collapses because the data isn't prepared, indexed or monitored.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Pinpoints data preparation, not model quality, as the real cause of failed AI rollouts.

quotes.text: The trap is simple. They don't wait for permission. Copilots pause for you. Autonomous agents don't, and when they make a bad call, the damage lands instantly and scales across your tenant.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clearly explains why autonomous agents carry a different risk profile than copilots.

quotes.text: Agents without scope don't politely stay in their lane. They thrash, They invent problems to fix, They duplicate records, They loop endlessly
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Vividly explains why agents need tightly scoped instructions.

quotes.text: Responsible doesn't kill velocity, It keeps velocity from killing you. Good governance means you can actually survive audits and still keep projects moving.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable reframing of responsible AI as an enabler rather than a brake.

chapters.title: Why Azure AI Foundry is called a trap
Why multimodal apps fail in the real world

takeaways: Multimodal and RAG apps fail on messy enterprise data unless retrieval is grounded with hybrid search and semantic reranking in Azure AI Search.
Agents and especially autonomous agents need tight scoping, least-privilege identities, logging, rollback and content filters before they touch production.
Azure AI Foundry provides evaluators, observability and content safety, but only governance-first lifecycle practices turn prototypes into reliable production systems.
hook: Azure AI Foundry demos look flawless, but real enterprise data turns many copilots and agents into hallucination machines. This episode is for architects, admins and AI builders moving from prototype to production. You learn how RAG with hybrid search, evaluators, observability and governance keep your AI grounded and your tenant safe.
